mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for three months), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 days as higher rates pressure equity valuations and reduce corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market activity, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals robust economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a dual shock of labor market weakness and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as both factors depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth above 1.0% annually), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days due to strong consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 1.0% annually, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.
